## Functions

### `parseHandprintIdx(imageBytes, labelBytes, { split, mapping } = {})`

Parse checked, decompressed IDX bytes. No executable dataset or model content.

### `handprintSample(dataset, index)`

Upright white-paper source pixels; IDX storage is transposed, not mirrored.

### `selectHandprintIndices(dataset, { partition, perClass, seed = 74219 } = {})`

Seeded balanced subsets never cross train/validation/test boundaries.

### `async prepareHandprintExamples(dataset, indices, { partition, signal, onProgress } = {})`

Developer training preparation uses the production Engine feature extractor.

## Constants

- `HANDPRINT_ALPHABET` — NIST EMNIST Balanced labels; fifteen uppercase labels also represent lowercase.
- `HANDPRINT_CASE_MERGED`
- `HANDPRINT_DATASET`
